source: Knock model v3 (knock calibration phase B, 2026-10-19): the parameter set of the map generator's knock replay, tau = scale * A * (OI/100)^on_exponent * (p/1 atm)^-pressure_exponent * exp(activation_k/T), integrated Livengood-Wu (ps/engine_cycle/knock.h). The compiled defaults in ps/engine_cycle/knock_model.h equal this file entry by entry (tests/unit/test_knock_cal_turbo.cpp 'KCB knock model file'). Fit: joint least squares of theta_kl - measured spark over the envelope rows of the Toyota A25A (EPA NVFEL, 17 rows, NA, KV1-BC) and the Honda L15B7 on EPA Tier 3 E10 (EPA NVFEL, 15 rows, MAP 98-196 kPa) at MEASURED boundary conditions (trapped air = measured air, measured intake temperature, lambda and cam phases, exhaust reservoir at ambient), constrained to every A25A row within +-5 deg. The measured ECU spark is the knock limit minus the OEM's own margin; like KV1-BC the fit treats measured spark as theta_kl with margin 0, so the calibrated model absorbs the OEM margin. Held out: Honda L15B7 on Tier 2 E0, Ford 2.7 EcoBoost (four packages); reported: Ford 1.6 EcoBoost, Mazda 2.5 T. Decision note: vault PHYS-069, docs/data_formats/engine.md 'Knock limit'.

prefactor_s.source: [AS] Douaud & Eyzat 1978 (SAE 780080) via Heywood 1988 sec. 9.6.2, not verified locally

octane_index_k.source: [AS] OI = RON - K*(RON - MON); K 0.5 = the anti-knock index (R+M)/2. A pressure/temperature-dependent K (SAE 2012-01-1634) was considered and rejected: the test fuels' sensitivity S is 7.5-9, so the measured MAP trend would need K about -3

prefactor_scale.source: [M] fitted (see source); v2 was 1.26 at the literature n and B

pressure_exponent.source: [M] fitted; literature 1.7. Optimum flat over 1.0-1.1 (rms 2.90-2.91 deg over the 32 fit rows)

activation_k.source: [M] fitted; literature 3800 K. Optimum flat over 5600-5800 K at n 1.05; not identifiable from the NA rows alone (v2 kept 3800)
